If you score ...
0–16: you are unlikely to get an acceptable score under examination conditions and we recommend that you spend a lot of time improving your English before you take IELTS.
17–25: you may get an acceptable score under examination conditions but we recommend that you think about having more practice or lessons before you take IELTS.
26–40: you are likely to get an acceptable score under examination conditions but remember that different institutions will find different scores acceptable.
